description: Sales Velocity for Effective Project Management by Office Solution A Sales Velocity chart provides the sales of products available in a country in the form of Needles. Sales Velocity is a powerful tool for analyzing the sales of products and identifying areas where these products are available. Key Components: Sales Velocity Chart: Comprises of the Pie region, Circle, and Needles. Needles: Indicate sales and percentage. The percentage is calculated globally. The longer needle represents a higher percentage, and the width of the needle depends on profit. Higher profit results in a broader needle. Pie Region and Circle: The size of the Pie Region and Circle radius depends on the "overall current sales" of each product in a country. Higher sales lead to a larger Pie Region and Circle. Colors: The color of Circles and Pie Regions ranges from Green (highest profit) to Red (lowest profit). Yellow indicates moderate profit. Middle Dot: Used to check whether current year sales are larger than the previous year. The color of the dot depends on the sales trends of available countries: Gray (no data or balanced sales), Red (more countries with decreasing sales), and Green (more countries with increasing sales).
